description: What’s coming: schemes proposed or starting soon, and recent changes to schemes in HouseFile’s records (started, ended, fee, dates or area changed), newest first. Optionally for one council, and for a number of months ahead and back (6 by default, at most 24). For all councils the lists stop at the 15 soonest schemes and the 10 latest changes, with the totals; ask for one council to see all of its own.

council.description: A council name, part of one, or its GSS code

within_months.description: Months ahead and back to look, 6 by default

name: upcoming_licensing_changes

note.description: What the stages mean, and how to see more when a list was cut short

recent_changes.description: Newest first, at most 10 when no council is given

recent_changes_total.description: How many changes there were in the window; more than listed when the list was cut short

upcoming.description: Soonest first, then proposals with no start date by council; at most 15 when no council is given

expected_start_date.description: Null where the council hasn’t announced a start date

upcoming_total.description: How many schemes are proposed or starting soon; more than listed when the list was cut short

title: Upcoming licensing changes
